accepted.quote: I oppose H.R. 3486, the Stop Illegal Entry Act. This bill would add draconian mandatory minimums and absurdly long maximum prison sentences, in some cases up to life imprisonment, to the existing criminal penalties for illegal entry and illegal reentry into the United States.
accepted.bill: H.R. 3486, the Stop Illegal Entry Act
accepted.rationale: Raskin explicitly opposes the bill expanding criminal penalties for illegal entry and reentry.

accepted.quote: Studies have repeatedly shown that mandatory minimums do not work to deter criminal behavior.
accepted.bill: H.R. 3486, the Stop Illegal Entry Act
accepted.rationale: Raskin states opposition to mandatory minimums as ineffective for deterrence.
